summary: frontend-orb preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<arch>.zip), extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it 0o755, and execFileSyncs it against math_init.js — a 727KB obfuscator.io-style bundle shipped in the tarball with rotated string arrays and a numeric constant table. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with _0xNNNN identifiers and per-function string-lookup maps. The package advertises itself as a CircleCI orb (src/ contains only orb YAML) and package.json declares main: index.js, but no index.js exists in the tarball, so the package has no library surface — the only auto-executed behavior on npm install is the preinstall runtime-dropper. Pulling in a second interpreter to execute a large obfuscated local blob bypasses inspection of Node-reachable code, and the declared package purpose has no need for a JS runtime or a 727KB compiled payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
